turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cafe needs a new plant milk option, and the supplier offered a few.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oat milk is the most popular, foams beautifully and tastes a bit sweet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Almond milk is lighter and nutty, but it can split in hot coffee.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Soy is cheap and creamy, though some customers say it tastes beany.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And there's a coconut milk blend that's great in iced drinks but strong tasting.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd make oat your main one and maybe keep soy as a cheaper second. Almond is tricky in hot drinks, and coconut is best saved for iced specials.
